placers.name: Koy Davidson
placers.note: No class year, so no profile under the current-classes rule - and he cannot mint under EITHER reading of his prints. He is the single unresolved placer key in Iowa: 1,108 of 1,109 resolved (99.9%), and he is the one cross-season print conflict in a state with 100% print coverage. Flo printed 'HS Senior' in two different years - 2024, which implies the class of 2024, and 2025, which implies 2025 - so one print is wrong and nothing in the payloads says which. RankWrestlers cannot break the tie: its health control passed for Iowa (Brayden Koester, Bettendorf, dated Fr/So/Jr/Sr all deriving 2027), proving coverage, but no Koy Davidson - and no Davidson of any first name in Iowa - exists in the RW index across two fresh search rounds, including the spelling variants 'Coy Davidson' and 'Koy Davison'. Held blank and never forced. He is the 2024 3A champion at 138 and 2025 runner-up at 144, so this is a champion deliberately recorded as unresolved rather than left to vanish; both of his placed rows ship with no grad year (3 Nov 2026).
